channel.title: Knowledge Recorder Updates
channel.description: Signed macOS updates for Knowledge Recorder.

item.description:
# Knowledge Recorder 1.1.86 — macOS update
## macOS
- Ask a Knowledge Space using the existing local Apple Intelligence provider on supported Macs. - Fixed question bar, progress/stop controls, Markdown answers, copy feedback and real source buttons. - Only reviewed, extracted text in the selected Space is eligible. Keyword ranking selects up to four excerpts from at most 200 items; this is not an exhaustive or semantic review. - Missing or changed sources are excluded. Fresh metadata checks avoid stale URL resource caches; source freshness and citation ranges are validated before displaying answers. - AI citations do not guarantee factual accuracy. Verify important claims against the supplied excerpts. - No cloud fallback, model-generated link navigation, remote images or saved multi-turn history. German and English help updated.
## Windows
No Windows executable in this release. The latest Windows installer remains 1.1.82. Shared changelogs and platform-adapted help are mirrored in the Windows repository.
SHA256: - `DesktopRecorder-macOS.dmg`: `75d273498f7580fda3310dc42b3dcecae2784233cd2811757162a40e2d2a22a4`

# Knowledge Recorder 1.1.85 — macOS update
## macOS
- Knowledge Spaces: organize Inbox entries into local groups with names, descriptions and colors. - Assign one primary Space per item and search within it, including previously extracted text. - Archive or restore groups. Deleting a Space preserves every Inbox entry and original file. - New imports join the selected active Space; existing references keep their assignment. - Existing Inbox data migrates with a preserved v1 backup. The new index needs version 1.1.85 or later. - German and English help updated. No automatic uploads, Space chat or Brain linking in this first stage.
## Windows
No Windows executable in this release. Latest Windows installer remains 1.1.82; platform-aware updates skip this macOS-only release. Platform-adapted help and shared changelogs are mirrored in the Windows source repository.
SHA256:
- `DesktopRecorder-macOS.dmg`: `91e6fe82a853ec0ed553c9f481081b05eb4c121658134e038997b9631f52da1d`

# Knowledge Recorder 1.1.84 — macOS update
## macOS
- Knowledge Inbox: Dateien per Auswahl, Drag-and-drop oder aus Notizen/Mediathek sammeln, ohne Originale zu verschieben. - Titel, Kurzbeschreibung und Tags prüfen und speichern; geprüfte Einträge werden sichtbar gekennzeichnet. - Lokale Text-/PDF-/Bilderkennung mit Abbruch, Größenlimits, Teilinhalt-Hinweisen und Prüfung geänderter Quellen. - Optionale Apple-Entwürfe für Kurzbeschreibungen: auf dem Mac, ohne automatischen Cloud-Wechsel und nur nach bewusster Übernahme. - Einheitliche Hell-/Dunkel-Oberfläche, feste Zeilenhöhen, Rückmeldungen und Erhalt ungespeicherter Entwürfe beim Bereichswechsel. - Deutsche und englische Hilfe aktualisiert. Audio/Video sind in dieser ersten Inbox-Version Referenzen; Spaces und Brain-Upload folgen separat.
Local Knowledge Inbox with file references, reviewable metadata, bounded local extraction and optional on-device Apple description drafts. Original files are preserved; no automatic cloud or Brain upload.
## Windows
No Windows binary in this release. Windows stays on 1.1.82; its platform-aware updater continues to offer that version. Inbox/Spaces parity will follow separately.
## Verification
Mac Studio: 284 ordinary tests passed, 7 intentionally skipped, 0 failed. Native Light/Dark/hover/pressed/disabled UI checks and a real Apple-model fixture completed. The macOS DMG is Developer-ID signed and Apple-notarized.
SHA256:
- `DesktopRecorder-macOS.dmg`: `1ee8d1e71f90eed69dee35f9ed8f4959421a17477be26e06815a1218f55e7884`
